lead: AI continues to reshape various industries, from aviation to enterprise solutions, while raising ethical concerns and driving innovation.

stories.title: Ryanair considers pay freezes and reducing crew on flights as fuel costs soar
stories.summary: Amid rising fuel costs due to geopolitical tensions, Ryanair is contemplating significant cost-cutting measures, including pay freezes and reduced crew numbers on flights. The airline is also looking to increase its use of AI to help mitigate the financial strain, with expectations that ticket prices across Europe may rise by up to 20%. This shift highlights the growing reliance on AI in the aviation sector as companies seek efficiency.

stories.title: The middle layer will make or break enterprise AI agents
stories.summary: The success of AI agents in enterprises hinges on the often-overlooked middleware that connects these agents to existing systems. While AI agents can execute actions and provide insights, their effectiveness is limited without robust integration into enterprise workflows. CIOs must focus on building the necessary infrastructure to support these technologies, ensuring that AI can operate effectively within complex business environments.

stories.title: ADNOC signs deal with OpenAI and G42 to deploy Frontier AI agents
stories.summary: Abu Dhabi's state oil company, ADNOC, has entered a multi-year partnership with OpenAI and G42 to integrate AI agents into its operations. This initiative marks a significant step for the energy sector, as ADNOC becomes the first company in the industry to utilize OpenAI's Frontier platform, showcasing the growing trend of AI adoption in traditional industries.

stories.title: India floats AI plan under which ‘The model travels to the data, rather than the data travelling to the model’
stories.summary: India is proposing an innovative AI strategy that emphasizes bringing AI models directly to the data instead of transferring data to the models. This approach aims to enhance local AI capabilities while minimizing reliance on major tech companies, reflecting a growing interest in data sovereignty and localized AI solutions.

stories.title: Westpac reveals AI cut data warehouse migration cost from $70m to $35m
stories.summary: Westpac has successfully reduced its data warehouse migration costs from $70 million to $35 million through the implementation of AI-driven solutions. This significant cost-saving demonstrates the potential of AI to streamline complex processes and enhance operational efficiency within financial institutions.

stories.title: AI is stealing Indigenous Australian art and churning out ‘Temu slop’, artist says
stories.summary: Indigenous Australian artist Sally Scales has raised concerns about AI technologies appropriating First Nations art, labeling the output as 'Temu slop.' Scales argues that AI undermines the authenticity and agency of Indigenous artists, highlighting the ethical implications of using AI in creative fields and the need for better protections for cultural heritage.

stories.title: Chatbots Are Leading Hikers Astray, With Dangerous Consequences
stories.summary: A growing reliance on AI chatbots for hiking advice has led to dangerous outcomes, as users may overlook critical thinking in favor of automated suggestions. This trend underscores the potential risks associated with outsourcing decision-making to AI, particularly in high-stakes environments like outdoor navigation.

stories.title: Voice cloning scams: How to protect yourself from audio deepfakes
stories.summary: As AI technology advances, voice cloning scams are becoming more prevalent, posing significant risks to personal security. This article outlines steps individuals can take to protect themselves from audio deepfakes, emphasizing the importance of awareness and proactive measures in an increasingly AI-driven world.
